purpose: The supported entrypoints of the ONB drama-song-ad-factory package, with the exit status each one actually produced when run. onboarding_adapter.py reads control.required_commands from here and refuses to pass if the live wrapper no longer offers them.

control.entrypoint_root_reason: scripts/openclaw_adapter.py is a relay: it runs this file as [sys.executable, entrypoint, *argv] and returns its exit code, so this file's import closure is what the entrypoint process can reach. 'Exposed' means reachable from here, not importable by the checker.
control.reachability_positive_controls_reason: both are known to be reached from factory.py (music_styles.music_styles via music_styles/suno_recipe.py, character_library.character_library via factory.py:3136). The walk must find them or the walk is broken and the receipt reports PROBE_INVALID instead of claiming anything is unreachable.
control.envelope_schema_source: scripts/openclaw_adapter.py docstring and a real relayed envelope

entrypoints.role: runtime entrypoint the docs and the box actually run
entrypoints.relays: argument array, no shell; stdout, stderr and exit code unchanged
entrypoints.notes: Runs without an isolated interpreter; it re-executes the entrypoint with sys.executable.

entrypoints.role: side-effect-free readiness check through the wrapper
entrypoints.notes: rc 2 is EXIT['waiting'], so the observed exit status agrees with the declared map. An empty root is expected to be waiting, not ok.

entrypoints.role: the shared control CLI named in SKILL.md
entrypoints.notes: Works because Python puts the script's own directory on sys.path, which is where the sibling 'intake' and 'preflight' modules live. It fails under python3 -I, which drops that directory; see not_advertised.

entrypoints.role: first-time install of the numbered skill folder onto a box
entrypoints.copies: install.sh:3994 cp -r "$ITEM" "$SKILLS_DIR/$SKILL_NAME/" copies the whole skill folder, so package/ and tests/fixtures/ ship
entrypoints.why_not_executed: install.sh mutates a live box (creates the OpenClaw tree and copies 76 skill folders). This unit is forbidden to mutate a box or to touch a client. The copy statement is cited from the script, not run.

entrypoints.role: additive update of an installed box
entrypoints.why_not_executed: Same reason as install: it mutates an installed box.

entrypoints.role: this unit's package check: proves each A29 clause against the live tree
entrypoints.notes: Read-only: no write path, no network, no provider call. 'check' exits 0 only when every required clause is PASS. rc 1 re-verified at head 55befb1cf (2026-10-26): the round-2 entrypoint_reachability clause reports the four capability modules unreachable from factory.py, and the owner decision on the row word 'exposes' (D-17: option A import-path vs option B reachable-at-runtime) is open, so the check fails as written. At unit base 8d583dfd6 the same command exits 0 with this fixture then carrying six clauses; the base rc 0 was recorded here until 2026-10-26 as 0, stale after round 2 added the reachability clause (defect CLAIM-1).

not_advertised.why: python3 -I drops the script's directory from sys.path, so the sibling 'intake' module cannot be found. This is a property of isolated mode, not a defect in factory.py, and the plain form works (rc 0). Advertise the wrapper for anything that needs an isolated interpreter.

not_advertised.observed_error: provider import fails: the module import itself is unaffected, but the accepted provider modules import their own siblings, which -I also hides
not_advertised.why: Run the package adapter without -I, the same way the repository's own suites are run.

controls_proving_each_capability.proves: the flavor seam resolves both flavors against one shared core; the adapter's own probe additionally compares STAGE_ORDER with the declared order and refuses an out-of-order stage
cast library, crowd group, anonymous-speaker and episode-setting gates accept and refuse their fixtures
synthetic-connection discovery, new/existing/mixed selection, duplicate titles and dead connections, with no live Notion call
the eighteen-style catalogue, its ids and its per-style traits
the delivery map on every default style prompt survives, so the catalogue did not regress the spoken/sung contract

unverified: install.sh and update-skills.sh were read, not executed; no box was mutated and no install receipt exists for this unit.
S75-T07 content-groundedness hardening is not in this base tree, so no check here can prove it; the adapter binds it when present and reports it absent.
registry.json is Skill 75's fifth held file and has no path in this tree; only the four held files that exist are digested.
